grades.quote: Any level of PTE may be a leaf PTE, so in addition to pages, Sv48 supports _megapages_ , _gigapages_ , and _terapages_ , each of which must be virtually and physically aligned to a boundary equal to its size. A page-fault exception is raised if the physical address is insufficiently aligned.
